transform.colorPolicy: Untagged pixels interpreted as sRGB; no measured color-space assertion

exportDetails.losslessScope: Exact transformed pixels, all channels verified

checks.detail: Untagged source explicitly interpreted as sRGB
Deterministic pixels prepared without undeclared enlargement

inspection.reviewer: Assistant after viewing original, unchanged previously inspected approved style input, decoded export, light/dark/checkerboard panels, both usage sizes and all eight current container colors; independent gait/readability observation by second assistant reviewer

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Viewed original and decoded runtime: one adult walking in side view facing left. Complete hands and both neutral shoes are visible, with no mat, ground plane, extra person or equipment.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Compared with the actual approved front-plank master: blue-gray top, muted terracotta leggings, hair bun, restrained contours, natural proportions and softly shaded educational finish remain consistent. Shoes have no visible text or branding.

checks.name: gait-readability
checks.observation: Upright trunk, low relaxed open-hand arm swing and heel/toe stride read as walking rather than a running leap. Near arm trails while near leg leads, a plausible opposite swing; side-profile overlap limits strict limb laterality. No obvious duplicated anatomy, disconnected joint or missing limb observed. Independent second reviewer agreed the relaxed-walking interpretation; no clinical gait validation is claimed.

checks.name: alpha-and-decoded-edges
checks.observation: Viewed source/export light and dark composites, decoded checkerboard and all eight current container colors. Surrounding area is transparent, with no visible rectangular backdrop, colored fringe or distracting matte halo; shoe outlines remain their intended neutral colors.

checks.name: usage-framing
checks.observation: Viewed actual source/export 256x144 and 320x180 panels and all eight current 320x180 container composites. The upright figure is narrow within the wide contain frame but walking silhouette, hands and shoes remain recognizable. Bun has a tight roughly 3dp top margin at 180dp height, with no observed clipping.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No visible text, numbers, arrows, labels, motion streaks, logos, watermark, app controls, phone frame or scenery observed.

limitations: Bun top margin is tight, approximately 3dp at 180dp height, but no clipping was observed.
Static gait observations do not prescribe pace or duration, establish clinical correctness, or certify exact left/right anatomy under side-profile overlap.
Untagged source pixels are explicitly interpreted as sRGB under the profile, without claiming measured embedded sRGB or a color conversion.

Usage boards are deterministic illustration composites using current presentation.json container colors, not actual RN/native component renders, text/control contrast measurements or signed-phone acceptance.
Human artwork and activation approval remain pending; no production promotion performed.
